ai_summary: Adani Power Limited has announced a Board meeting for October 23, 2026, to approve its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This routine disclosure also details a trading window closure for designated persons from October 1st to October 26th, accompanying an investor/analyst call scheduled for October 26th to discuss the results and business outlook. This communication is a standard regulatory filing and presents no red flags.
